prepareExport.returns: internal export-intent descriptor including readerPinId; not a schema ExportJob before nonempty artifacts/attempts exist

prepareAttempts.signature: prepareAttempts({exportJobId, volumes:[{bytes:Uint8Array, filename, blobUrl, rowCount}]}, sender)
prepareAttempts.purpose: Compute raw SHA-256 and validate all descriptors before transaction; persist byte chunks and fresh URL per volume atomically.

readArtifact.purpose: Authenticated host byte access for retry; verify raw-byte hash after IDB read transaction.

dispatchDownload.purpose: Only prepared-to-dispatched commit winner may call downloads.download once; ACK never waits for Chrome callback; duplicate/gap never replays.

reconcileDownload.purpose: Trusted foundation audit. Callback/known ID searched by ID; missing ID searched with exact URL and bounded time filters; candidates also checked by full URL/extension/time.

reconcilePending.purpose: Trusted recovery/alarm audit only; never dispatches; skips terminal/deadline_unknown automatic polling. Conflict gets one deadline audit to release durable raw-record pin, then stops polling.

recordResourceRelease.purpose: Owning RunHost calls after its registry revoked the URL. Persist true release timestamp only after host ACK; rejects active early release and clock rollback; preserves original release history.

retryExport.purpose: Host obtains original bytes and creates fresh URLs first; service creates new artifacts/job/attempts and freezes old submission authority atomically. Original delivery aggregate remains auditable. Exact duplicate request returns original new job without fresh input.

abandonExport.purpose: Freeze original job, abandon unresolved attempts, release durable reader pin; late observations only audit.

abandonRun.purpose: Internal deletion hook only, not a user message route. Requires tombstone OR terminal run retirementState=released and @slot no longer owned. Releases export pins and abandons jobs before storage.deleteRun.

handleCreated.purpose: Trusted top-level SW route; cache only matching full-identity candidates and search before receipt.

handleChanged.purpose: Trusted top-level SW route; delta is only trigger; search confirms terminal state and interrupt reason.

attach.purpose: Optional explicit listener registration; SW must instead register top-level listeners synchronously and route to handleCreated/handleChanged after initialization.

drain.purpose: Await local background submission/listener tasks for tests/shutdown observation; propagates background storage failures.

hostExports.hashArtifactBytes: hashArtifactBytes(Uint8Array) -> Promise<lowercase SHA-256 hex>; raw bytes, not canonical JSON
hostExports.canReleaseBlob: canReleaseBlob(attempt, epochMs=Date.now(), {readerPinned=false}) -> bool; verified complete/interrupted, explicit abandoned, or downloadDeadline reached. Mapping-unknown and conflict alone do not allow early revoke.
hostExports.createHostBlobRegistry: createHostBlobRegistry({url=URL,BlobClass=Blob,clock=Date.now}) -> {create(bytes,mime):freshBlobUrl, pin(blobUrl):idempotentUnpin, release(attempt,{readerPinned}):bool, has(blobUrl):bool}; RunHost only; no automatic unsafe disposal

downloadReceipts.attempt:{attemptId}: tag attempt, nested strict DownloadAttempt plus top-level runId/exportJobId/artifactId/attemptId/state/fullBlobUrl; boundDownloadId present only when bound; internal callbackDownloadId and finite-search metadata

downloadReceipts.candidate:{downloadId}: tag candidate, downloadId/fullBlobUrl/byExtensionId/startTime/state/interruptReason; dedupe same ID; not sufficient terminal evidence without search

storage.cryptoTransactions: canonical/hash calculations run before or after transactions; transaction callbacks await only tx get/put/all requests and helpers containing such requests
